QImage preprocess(const QImage &crop, const PreprocessOptions &options)
{
    if (crop.isNull()) {
        return QImage();
    }

    QImage gray = crop.convertToFormat(QImage::Format_Grayscale8);

    if (meanLuminance(gray) < kDarkThreshold) {
        gray.invertPixels();
    }

    const int factor = effectiveUpscale(options);
    if (factor > 1) {
        gray = gray.scaled(gray.width() * factor,
                           gray.height() * factor,
                           Qt::IgnoreAspectRatio,
                           Qt::SmoothTransformation);
    }

    return gray;
}
